name: Nabu Model Router
description: Haiku-orchestrated router that classifies each prompt and dispatches to Haiku, Sonnet, or Opus.

providerId.label: Provider id
providerId.help: openclaw provider id whose baseUrl and headers the classifier reuses (default: cloudflare-ai-gateway)

classifier.model.label: Classifier model
classifier.model.help: Model used to classify request complexity. Should be a fast, cheap tier (default: claude-haiku-4-5)

classifier.timeoutMs.label: Classifier timeout (ms)
classifier.timeoutMs.help: Hard timeout for the classifier call. On timeout the router falls back to the configured default model.

classifier.apiKeyEnvVar.label: API key env var
classifier.apiKeyEnvVar.help: Env var that holds the provider API key (default: CLOUDFLARE_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY)

escalateOnLowConfidence.label: Escalate on low confidence
escalateOnLowConfidence.help: When the classifier reports low confidence, bump up one tier (simple→medium, medium→hard).
